params.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

params.name: exclude_fields
params.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

params.name: offset
params.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this it the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

params.name: created_by
params.description: The Mailchimp account user who created the template.

params.name: since_date_created
params.description: Restrict the response to templates created after the set date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

params.name: before_date_created
params.description: Restrict the response to templates created before the set date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

params.name: type
params.description: Limit results based on template type.

params.name: category
params.description: Limit results based on category.

params.name: folder_id
params.description: The unique folder id.

params.name: sort_field
params.description: Returns user templates sorted by the specified field.

params.name: content_type
params.description: Limit results based on how the template's content is put together. Only templates of type `user` can be filtered by `content_type`. If you want to retrieve saved templates created with the legacy email editor, then filter `content_type` to `template`. If you'd rather pull your saved templates for the new editor, filter to `multichannel`. For code your own templates, filter to `html`.

params.name: sort_dir
params.description: Determines the order direction for sorted results.
